prepare_model_single_device: prepare a PyTorch model with optimizer and param scheduler for single device training
convert_syncbn_to_batchnorm: convert all SyncBatchNorm layers in a model to standard BatchNormXd layers for single device use
load_checkpoint_single_device: load a model checkpoint from file with optional key revision and callback support
resume_training_single_device: resume training from a checkpoint restoring model optimizer scheduler and random seed state
save_checkpoint_single_device: save model optimizer and scheduler state to a checkpoint file with metadata and callbacks
